text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: You seem less energetic than usual...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I caught a student reading manga
in the classroom earlier and gave 'em a warning, but..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And then... I made 'em cry.
My voice was way too loud,
and it must've scared 'em... Ugh, darn it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Failing to be considerate according to the other person's needs...
I'm a failure as Disciplinary Committee Head... I'm so pathetic."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seemed quite downhearted
about having inadvertently frightened the other person.
